question: According to Census of India 2011, what was the sex ratio of Tamil Nadu?
solution:
The correct answer is __996__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sex ratio of Tamil Nadu in population as per the 2011 census is 996.__
 
• According to the 2011 census, Tamil Nadu ranks seventh in the population.
 __
 
• The top six states by rank are Uttar Pradesh, Maharashtra, Bihar, West Bengal, Andhra Pradesh and Madhya Pradesh.
 
• Tamil Nadu has a sex ratio of 996 as of the 2011 census.
 
• It was 987 in the 2001 census.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__

 
• Census:​

 
 
• In 1872 AD, the first Non-synchronised Census was done in India during the time of Lord Mayo.
 
• The first synchronized census in India took place in 1881.
 
• Since 1901, it has been taking place after every decade.
 
• Census 2011, is the 15th census and 7th after independence.
 
• The slogan of Census 2011 is* “Our Census, Our Future”.*
 
 
 
• Census of India, 2011:
 
 
• Total population of India- 1,21,08,54,977
 
• Sex Ratio (females per thousand males) – 943
 
• Density- 382 persons per sq.km.
 
• Infant Mortality Rate (2006) - 57 per thousand live births
 
• Maternal Mortality Rate - 407 per lakh live births
 
• Literacy rate of the country - 73 percent (Male - 80.9%, Female - 64.6%)
 
• Highest literacy state - Kerala (94.0%)
 
• Lowest literacy state- Bihar (61.8%)
 
• State with highest female literacy rate - Kerala (92.1%)
